description: Performs repeated HTTP POST requests to a controlled API-style endpoint using the .NET HttpClient API. The sample sends structured JSON heartbeat telemetry and configures browser/application-style request headers to mimic legitimate REST-style telemetry traffic from a desktop client.

telemetry_client.role: generates periodic HTTP POST requests containing telemetry-style JSON heartbeat data and application-like request headers

server_response.role: static INetSim fakefile response returned by the controlled HTTP API-style endpoint

network_behavior.mimicked_protocol_pattern: legitimate REST-style desktop telemetry API traffic

beacon_behavior.description: The sample configures application-like HTTP headers, builds a JSON telemetry heartbeat payload, submits it to a controlled API endpoint, records the HTTP response status, sleeps for a fixed interval, and repeats for a fixed number of iterations.
expected_actions: build JSON heartbeat payload with session identifier
include event_type heartbeat in JSON body
include UTC ISO 8601 timestamp in JSON body
send HTTP POST request using HttpClient.PostAsync
log HTTP status code returned by server

protocol_mimicry_behavior.description: The sample disguises simple periodic beaconing as benign application telemetry by using realistic REST-style endpoint naming, JSON request bodies, versioned client metadata, and browser/application-style HTTP headers.

code_placement: Protocol mimicry and telemetry-style beaconing logic are implemented directly inside the managed C# executable using .NET HttpClient APIs
execution_trigger: Program entry point starts the telemetry POST loop automatically
execution_target: controlled HTTP API-style endpoint at api.lab.local

telemetry_client: HttpClient.PostAsync used for outbound HTTP POST requests
StringContent used to build application/json request body
JSON string construction containing session_id, event_type, timestamp, application, version, and status fields

network: outbound HTTP POST requests to api.lab.local
approximately 15 second interval between POST requests
HTTP 200 OK response from controlled INetSim server
process: A05_3_protocol_mimicry.exe runs as a standalone process
no downloaded payload is written to disk
host: console output shows protocol mimicry sample startup
console output logs each sent request number
console output logs HTTP status code and reason phrase
program exits after completing all iterations

semantic_meaning: Demonstrates a controlled protocol mimicry pattern in which a program disguises periodic beaconing as legitimate REST-style desktop telemetry by sending JSON heartbeat data to an API-like endpoint with realistic application headers, version metadata, and structured event fields.

control_notes.payload_effect: generates observable HTTP POST telemetry-style beacon traffic only

success_conditions: Windows VM resolves api.lab.local to the INetSim server
INetSim returns a static response for /v1/telemetry
sample builds telemetry-style JSON heartbeat payloads
sample sends repeated HTTP POST requests to /v1/telemetry
requests include X-Client-Version and X-Request-Origin headers
POST bodies include session_id, event_type, timestamp, application, version, and status fields
INetSim service.log records the telemetry POST requests
INetSim postdata captures contain JSON heartbeat bodies
PCAP captures show repeated HTTP POST traffic
console output reports HTTP response status for each request
